tldr: Q2 FY27 saw strong launch momentum with Tata.CARS brand and Aeris sedan in India, and three new luxury EVs at JLR.
Consolidated revenue ~Rs. 97,000 Cr, up 34% YoY; EBITDA margin 6.2%, EBIT margin 1.1%; PBT before exceptional items ~Rs. 400 Cr.
Exceptional charges of Rs. 6,700 Cr recorded at JLR.
Consolidated net debt closed at ~Rs. 51,000 Cr.
India business revenue hit Rs. 20,000 Cr, up 50% YoY, with EV market share 43% and 23% penetration.
management_commentary: Launch of Tata.CARS brand and Aeris sedan drove best‑ever offtake and retail month in October 2026.
JLR launched three new luxury electric vehicles with deliveries expected from early 2027.
Alternate powertrains now account for more than half of volumes.
Commodity pressures expected to remain elevated in Q3 with further increases in steel, rubber, and copper.
Strong portfolio launches drive growth; capacity expansion underway.
Will capitalize on greener powertrains and scale production capacity.
Strengthening profitability through cost reduction, PLI approvals, and pricing actions.
We will keep increasing price progressively where headroom exists.
We are confident we can offset PLI benefits with price and cost strategies.
guidance: FY28 double‑digit EBITDA and cash generation.

notable_qa.question: How are commodity pressures expected to evolve?
notable_qa.answer: Commodity pressures remain elevated in Q3 with further increases in steel, rubber, and copper, but are expected to plateau in Q4.

notable_qa.question: What is the plan for Capex?
notable_qa.answer: H1 Capex was Rs. 2,700 Cr; we expect higher spending over the next 18 to 24 months for capacity builds.

notable_qa.question: What percentage of bookings are EVs?
notable_qa.answer: Roughly 30% of bookings are EV bookings, 40–45% of pending bookings are EVs.

notable_qa.question: What is the rough price hike this year?
notable_qa.answer: About 1.7% across ICE and EV models.

notable_qa.question: What benefit will we get in FY27/FY28?
notable_qa.answer: £1.7bn split across ex‑works, warranty, and cost efficiencies.
